experiment_title: Spatial separation + selective retention vs CereVasc baseline: CSF and tissue drug exposure comparison
objective: Determine whether the spatial separation + retention architecture produces materially greater target-tissue drug exposure than CereVasc's existing delivery method, while preserving CSF drainage.

design.animal_model: Ovine (sheep) — established CSF shunt model, 40-60 kg

groups.description: CereVasc existing delivery (endovascular, no retention, no spatial separation)

design.drug: Fluorescent drug surrogate (e.g., FITC-dextran 150 kDa, matching bevacizumab MW) for quantitative tissue measurement

primary_endpoint.endpoint: Target-tissue AUC (brain-adjacent tissue drug concentration × time)
primary_endpoint.hypothesis: Group B AUC ≥ 200% of Group A AUC (model predicts 327% median)
primary_endpoint.success_threshold: Group B AUC ≥ 120% of Group A (conservative — model overestimates by ~50%)
primary_endpoint.failure_threshold: Group B AUC ≤ 100% of Group A (no improvement)
primary_endpoint.power: n=6 per group provides 80% power to detect 100% difference (effect size d=1.2)

secondary_endpoints.measurement: Venous blood sampling at same timepoints
Post-mortem fluorescence imaging of brain tissue

acceptance_criteria.primary: Group B tissue AUC ≥ 120% of Group A (p<0.05)
acceptance_criteria.safety: ICP < 20 mmHg in both groups; CSF drainage ≥ 0.3 mL/min in both groups
acceptance_criteria.direction: If Group B shows ANY improvement in the correct direction, proceed to larger study
acceptance_criteria.failure: If Group B AUC ≤ Group A or ICP unsafe → architecture does not work in vivo

failure_criteria.if_no_improvement: The model is structurally wrong. Return to model development. Do NOT claim the architecture works.
failure_criteria.if_unsafe: The spatial separation or retention mechanism interferes with drainage. Architecture is not clinically viable.
failure_criteria.if_improvement_but_below_threshold: The direction is correct but magnitude is smaller than predicted. Recalibrate model and reassess buyer value.

estimated_cost: $50,000 (12 animals + surgery + fluorescence analysis + CSF sampling)
estimated_timeline: 12 weeks (4 weeks setup, 4 weeks in-life, 4 weeks analysis)

decision_tree.AUC_B ≥ 200% of AUC_A: BUYABLE CONFIRMED — proceed to patent filing + partnership discussions
decision_tree.AUC_B 120-200% of AUC_A: MILESTONE-WORTHY — improvement confirmed but smaller than model; recalibrate and reassess
decision_tree.AUC_B ≤ 120% of AUC_A: TRUE CEILING — model overestimated; architecture does not produce material in vivo advantage
decision_tree.ICP unsafe or drainage not preserved: ARCHITECTURE FAILED — safety issue, redesign required

ceo_directive_compliance: The key test is not 'did we get 327%?' It is: 'Does the direction and magnitude of advantage survive physical validation?'
